# `repomap`

> Profile: core · Permission key: `[permission] repomap`

Signature map of a directory: declaration-like lines (fn/struct/class/impl), packed to a token budget. Use to orient before `read`. Not a full dump — bodies are omitted. Served from the live file index when warm.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_files` | integer | no | Max source files to inspect (default: 80) |
| `max_tokens` | integer | no | Approximate token budget for the whole map (default: 4000, max: 16000) |
| `path` | string | no | Directory or file to map (default: project root) |
